findings.observation: Skin band, asymmetric blonde hair, brow notch, small upturned nose, and heavy lower lip relate to the summon, but enlarged round eyes, softened cheeks, and a tiny rounded jaw make the face read childlike rather than unmistakably 22-year-old Weni.

The compact figure retains the source’s ordinary lean-to-average construction, medium height language, shoulder and torso width, soft mass, sturdy legs, and un-defined musculature without generic obesity.
Upper arms, forearms, wrists, and both empty hands remain coherent with the source; the forward hand’s larger read follows the source pose and foreshortening rather than generic inflation.
The blonde-gold extreme asymmetric silhouette preserves the source swept parting, long gathered mass on one side, and exposed shaved side.

Rust-charcoal quilted outerwear, simple underlayer, broad folded collar, divided hem, tapered trousers, seams, closures, pouch, and palette remain source-faithful, but the exposed temple shows two paired ornaments totaling four visible hair rings rather than exactly three.
The complete hair-top-to-chin unit visually occupies about 31% of the standing figure height, producing a figure slightly taller than 3.1 heads; this is not clearly inside the frozen 32–36% band.
Exactly one figure is shown with the complete hair silhouette, head, both empty hands, garment edges, both legs, and both feet fully inside generous margins.
The grounded broad ready-idle stance, separated arms, compact silhouette, and visible feet read cleanly at combat-icon scale without a weapon.

The quilted cloth outfit remains ordinary mortal gear; no weapon, attack, armor upgrade, magic, aura, glow, affinity cue, elemental gem, floating, frame, star, number, UI, text, logo, or watermark appears.
